title: Cover pinned child tracked deletion and Unix mode changes with restored positives
outcome: Child cleanliness tests directly witness tracked deletion refusal and Unix executable-mode refusal despite local core.fileMode=false.
acceptance: A real pinned-child test removes a tracked source file, requires production refusal, restores it and requires the original admitted revision.

On Unix a tracked mode-change test sets local core.fileMode=false, requires production refusal through the command-pinned mode check, restores the mode and requires the original revision; removing the command pin must fail the counterexample.
All mutations stay in disposable fixtures; no production semantics or bounds are weakened.
